rules.name: SECURITY_BLOCK
rules.conditions: ctx.security_blocked == True or ctx.security_violations is not empty
rules.rationale: Security invariant violation detected by Security Sentinel. Operational loop halted immediately.

rules.name: BUDGET_EXCEEDED
rules.rationale: Autonomous budget exceeded (adaptations, repairs, or consecutive failures). Requires human governance.

rules.name: OSCILLATION_DETECTED
rules.rationale: State repetition cycle detected (A -> B -> A). Loop halted to prevent infinite churn.

rules.name: UNEXPECTED_DRIFT
rules.rationale: Mission intent/requirements drifted beyond tolerance without formal intent amendment.

rules.name: HUMAN_APPROVAL_PENDING
rules.rationale: Action requires explicit human authorization or economic clearance under Mission Gate.

rules.name: TERMINAL_FINISH
rules.conditions: all_requirements_satisfied and all_validations_passed and evidence_complete and not active_failures
rules.rationale: All mission requirements verified with empirical proof under Zero False Success standard.

rules.name: REPAIR_VERIFIED
rules.rationale: Self-healing repair succeeded and produced verified AST/test evidence. Resuming mission.

rules.name: AGENT_UNAVAILABLE
rules.rationale: Task owner agent disconnected or crashed; compatible agent available in swarm.

rules.name: REPAIRABLE_FAILURE
rules.conditions: ctx.active_failures is not empty and ctx.failure_is_repairable and repairs_count < max_repairs
rules.rationale: Validation/build failure is repairable via localized AST diagnostic patch.

rules.name: UNREPAIRABLE_FAILURE
rules.conditions: ctx.active_failures is not empty and (not ctx.failure_is_repairable or repairs_count >= max_repairs)
rules.rationale: Failure cannot be repaired surgically; requiring structural DAG replan.

rules.name: PLAN_INVALID_OR_NEW_DEP
rules.conditions: ctx.plan_invalid or ctx.new_dependencies_discovered is not empty
rules.rationale: New file/package dependency discovered dynamically; DAG must be reconstructed.

rules.name: PREDICTION_DEVIATION
rules.conditions: ctx.prediction_outcome and ctx.prediction_outcome.unexpected_changes is not empty and satisfiable
rules.rationale: Observed execution touched unexpected files; adapting DAG validation scope to maintain integrity.

rules.name: INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE
rules.rationale: Asynchronous validation tasks or browser telemetry still recording evidence.

rules.name: DEFAULT_PROGRESS
rules.rationale: Plan is valid, prediction matches reality, advancing to next executable task.
